'''Haverous Mok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] head of an engineering corporation called [[Sorintechnic]], who was a major clandestine supplier of ship-grade weapons for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
